_comment: Lebanon construction/engineering/design-consultancy pitch. User's exact fixed copy, no signal variation. Salutation slot is the only change from the source text. No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Hope things are moving well on your end. Watching how firms are positioning for the reconstruction work, I've noticed the real race isn't on site, it's in the office: whoever reads the RFP, prices it with today's material costs and gets a clean, compliant file out first is the one who wins. Most teams still do all of that by hand, over weeks, while estimates go stale as prices shift.

I'm David Geha, a third year Engineering student at AUB, and I work with OSG (https://osgdev.com). We're AI consultants: we find where a business is losing time and money and build AI systems around those exact gaps. We've done this for marketing agencies, F&B businesses and oil and gas companies across Lebanon and the GCC.

Would you have 20 minutes for a call to go through the details? If it's easier, you can call or WhatsApp me directly on +961 76 412 978.

Best regards,
David Geha
OSG
https://osgdev.com
Instagram: dave.automates
